answers.justification: Approved scope is one-year RMDQ among all randomized participants, antibiotic combined-dose versus placebo combined-dose; assignment effect. The report says 144/162 (88.9%) completed one-year follow-up (page 4) and flow chart breaks this down as 77/90 antibiotic (85.6%) and 67/72 placebo (93.1%), while the analyzed follow-up table reports those same denominators and median RMDQ values 7 versus 14 (page 7). Thus 18/162 lack follow-up, materially below near-complete ascertainment; the 5.7 antibiotic abstract value conflicts with detailed table value 7.0 but both refer to followed participants, so missing outcomes remain consequentially unresolved. ITT-group analysis applies only to one-year participants, not all randomized.
unknowns: RMDQ-specific observed counts beyond general one-year questionnaire completion are not separately given.
Outcomes for 18 participants without one-year follow-up and their relation to true RMDQ values are unknown.
Abstract reports antibiotic RMDQ 5.7, conflicting with table median 7.0.

counterevidence.implication: 144 completed one-year questionnaire follow-up; 88.9% is not nearly all for this continuous outcome and smokers were more frequent among those lost.

limitations.premise: RMDQ-specific exact observed/missing counts and the missingness mechanism for the 18 without one-year follow-up are not reported.
limitations.stopping_rationale: Read the complete restored main article and relevant flow/outcome pages; the historical registry capture integrity check fails, so it cannot be used and no replacement was sought. Retain uncertainty rather than infer RMDQ availability or missing values.

missing_data.population: All randomized participants in antibiotic and placebo comparison groups
missing_data.event_definition: RMDQ questionnaire available at one-year follow-up
